title: JopeDime binary classification fitness v1
description: Strict binary objectives on calibrated probabilities (spec §5.10). Both minimize. Runtime bounds spec JSON to 32 KiB, refuses duplicate keys, and enforces input alignment, class membership/order and probability sums. Calibration and event integration are separate. Multiclass is deferred.

metric.description: logloss: -ln(p_true) without clipping; zero true-class probability fails the candidate. brier: (p_positive - is_positive)^2, without a factor of two; positive is class_order[1]. Both are defined on a single-class fold.

aggregation.description: Unweighted arithmetic mean or sum of row losses over all supplied held-out rows, in input order. No row is omitted.

undefined.description: Invalid inputs, undefined/non-finite losses or predictions return FITNESS_UNDEFINED for this candidate only. Never return a placeholder score or fail the whole run.

class_order.description: Two distinct exact class names in probability-column order; class_order[1] is positive.

inputs.description: Runtime additionally requires equal nonzero row counts, exact agreement with the specification's class_order, labels drawn from those classes, finite probabilities and each pair summing to one within absolute tolerance 1e-12. No renormalization or clipping.
